blocks.title: Software development
blocks.text: Software development computer programs banane ka amal hai jo khaas kaam (tasks) anjaam dene ke liye banaye jate hain. Is mein code likhna, use test karna aur paida hone wale masail hal karna shamil hai.

Software development is liye aham hai ke yeh masail hal karne mein madad deta aur hamari zindagi aasan banata hai. Maslan software hamein social media par doston se rabta karne deta hai, banking apps se paisa sambhalne mein madad deta hai, aur taleemi games se seekhna dilchasp banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Do rozmarra misalein dijiye jo dikhayein ke software development kyun aham hai.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: social media apps doston se baat karne dete hain; banking apps paisa sambhalne mein madad dete hain; taleemi games seekhna dilchasp banate hain.

items: Software development: khaas kaamon ke liye programs banana, code likh kar, test kar ke aur masail theek kar ke.
Yeh aham hai kyunke software masail hal karta hai: social media, banking apps, taleemi games.
